Abebook.title: Pindar and the Cult of Heroes

Abebook.description: First paperback issue (2010) of Currie's 2005 Oxford monograph, published in the Oxford Classical Monographs series. Softcover in dark green pictorial laminated wrappers reproducing a Syracusan silver decadrachm; no dust jacket, as issued. As new: the spine is unbroken and uncreased, the wrappers bright and unrubbed, and the text block is entirely clean and unmarked; the only wear is very slight bumping to the corners. A study of hero cult in Archaic and Classical Greece and of its bearing on Pindar's epinicians, with five odes interpreted in detail.
